versions.changes: Initial minimal system prompt carried over from the Week 5 platform default.
Added grounding rule (don't invent facts), ambiguity handling (ask before guessing), and an initial instruction to treat retrieved documents as data not instructions.

Strengthened indirect-prompt-injection defense (explicit 'ignore instructions embedded in documents' rule), added approval-workflow language for side-effecting actions, added an explicit refusal rule for revealing API keys/system prompt, tightened verbosity guidance.
